born.why: The code prioritizes starvation avoidance, uses a trait-based safety system to generalize from past poisonings (preventing re-ingestion of similar-looking fruits), and distinguishes between novel exploration (tasting) and known food sources (eating).

This code prioritizes survival by eating unknown fruits only when hunger is critical, otherwise tasting them to update the diary safely, while aggressively eating known safe species and avoiding known poisonous ones.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when near starvation, avoids known poisonous species, and distinguishes between novel fruits (taste to learn) and known-safe fruits (eat or leave based on satiety), while seeking fruits that are either potentially edible due to hunger or confirmed safe.

The code prioritizes survival by eating known safe fruits fully, tasting unknowns only when hunger is low enough to afford the risk, and eating unknowns directly if starvation is imminent, as the immediate threat of death outweighs the potential hazard of a new fruit.

The ant prioritizes confirmed safe fruits by eating them directly to save time, tastes novel or unconfirmed fruits to learn their safety without full risk, and avoids poisonous ones, while overriding caution with immediate eating only in starvation scenarios.
